geolocated.label: Limit the geographic reach of the ad
geolocated.help: Your ad is then only visible to people within a radius around the starting point. Ideal for things to pick up or help on site. Leave unchecked if it's meant for your whole network, wherever they are.

radius.label: Sharing radius
radius.help: People located beyond this radius will not see your ad.

limited_duration.label: Limit the duration of the ad
limited_duration.help: Without a limit, your ad stays visible until you delete it.

expiry.label: Expires in
expiry.help: After this delay, your ad disappears from your contacts' feed. It stays in "My ads", where you can extend it.
